description: This header defines a TestSemaphore class for POSIX thread synchronization, including methods for semaphore operations, thread entry points, and thread management utilities, used for testing POSIX thread behavior.

classes.name: TestSemaphore
classes.description: A POSIX semaphore implementation for testing, with methods to Put, Take, and TryTake permits.

classes.name: WaiterContext
classes.description: A struct managing thread waiting and signaling with mutex and condition variables.

classes.name: TakeThenSignalContext
classes.description: An aggregate for synchronization involving a semaphore, mutex, condition, and delay parameter.

classes.name: AbstractTestThread
classes.description: A base class for creating and managing threads in tests, requiring subclasses to override Run().

methods.name: TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing permits to zero.

methods.name: TestSemaphore(int initial_thread_permits)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permits to a specified value.

methods.name: ~TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up mutex and condition variables.

methods.name: Put()
methods.description: Increments permits and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: Take()
methods.description: Blocks until permits > 0, then decrements permits.

methods.name: TakeTry()
methods.description: Attempts to decrement permits without blocking; returns success status.

methods.name: ToVoid(intptr_t value)
methods.description: Converts an integer to a void pointer.

methods.name: FromVoid(void* value)
methods.description: Converts a void pointer back to an integer.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Waits on condition, increments unreturned_waiters, signals return_condition.

methods.name: WaitForReturnSignal()
methods.description: Waits until unreturned_waiters > 0, then takes one.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be overridden by subclasses to define thread behavior.

methods.name: Join()
methods.description: Joins the thread, with failure handling.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint(void* ptr)
methods.description: Static method that sets thread name and calls Run() on the subclass instance.
